events: Photo material installation/program key was corrected to preserve explicit vault texture overrides and plaster; found during code inspection before regression gate.

Old static-transform regression referenced removed cloud[0]; replaced it with animated sky-uniform progress and included the mutable sky in transform exclusions. Initial targeted run: 13 pass/1 fail; fixed static gate: 2/2 pass.
Source image inspection confirmed bright leaf litter and brown rock; restored a distinct pale salt-region blend before freeze.

limitations: No actual WebGL draw, native shader compilation, browser image decoding, visual screen comparison, touch or iOS/Android FPS/memory/power measurement occurred.
The three photo texture files add 3,403,723 network bytes and approximately 16 MiB RGBA8+mip residency plus a 256 KiB single-channel contact field; smartphone impact is unmeasured.
Stone has three additional normal texture taps; terrain has one contact tap; near trees enter the existing directional shadow pass. Equal triangles do not establish equal frame time.

Wood, cloth, bark and leaf materials, tree/grass/rock/architecture meshes, flames and other small props still use authored code-native simplifications. No imported photogrammetric mesh, actor facial performance, real fluid simulation, baked GI or screen-space reflection.
The sky reflection is an analytic lighting approximation and does not reflect scene objects. Ground contact is static soft shading from obstacle centres, not dynamic actor shadow or SSAO.
Completion acceptance remains 0/7 and fixed ten-game comparison remains 0/10. PS4-quality equivalence is not claimed.
